mapper.select: SELECT clock_id, current_datetime AS base_datetime, reference_real_datetime, TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, reference_real_datetime, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ), current_datetime ) AS current_datetime FROM system_clock WHERE clock_id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE system_clock SET current_datetime = #{newDatetime}, reference_real_datetime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE clock_id = 1 AND reference_real_datetime = #{expectedReferenceRealDatetime}
